about.text:
I'm a systems and network engineer with more than seven years of work on Windows and Linux servers, Cisco firewalls, Active Directory, Entra ID and enterprise application support.

I hold the SSCP and eJPT, I'm working toward the CISSP, and I have a postgraduate certificate in cybersecurity from George Brown College.

Outside work I build web applications with tenant isolation, role-based access control (RBAC) and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
